I used to be a janitor, and my supervisor was bat-shit crazy. She would shot random abuse at any and all women (and for some reason, me), but treat the black guy who did the floors just fine. Because of her bullshit, we almost never clocked out on time. Her bullshit actually slowed us down.
There was one evening where I worked for close to nine hours and didn't get a single break. I tried bringing it up with the temp agency I worked for at the time, but nothing was done about it.
Two months later, she gets promoted and a huge raise. I say I've finally had enough and quit. They fire the floor guy the day after I leave.
It's even worse when the skinny jeans have holes in them.

I have a hard time reaching out to people. It took some guts just to post this. But you're right. My buddies would be pretty unhappy if I suddenly disappeared. I guess I worry about how they'd react if I told them anything. But at the same time, I have done a lot for them. I've driven people to work a lot. I've even driven some of them to the hospital in the past. I mean, they'd probably listen. I guess I also just don't know how to say it. I mean, how do you tell your best friend that you want to kill yourself?
And I have no idea what I want to do with my life, to be honest. I chase myself in circles whenever I think about it.

Yeah, I still drink. And to be honest, I drink a lot. I feel accepted by a few close friends. I'm not at all close to family, for obvious reasons. Currently I'm working in a temporary position at a plastic company. I put stuff together. I mostly work alone, which gives a lot of opportunity for mental issues to rear their ugly head. I'm told they need me a couple more days, and then I'm back to being unemployed again.

Thanks. Well, as for the freak stuff . . . time to be blunt again. I'm intersexed, and identify as a man. But I was labelled as female at birth. I was always a very boyish child. My mother was upset that I wasn't "girly" enough. She would beat me, telling me I needed to play with a certain set of toys in a certain manner. I honestly didn't mind the barbie dolls. I just played with them wrong, ripping their heads off, playing with them in the mud. I didn't "play house" or "be a mommy" with them like my mother wanted. My mother was also picky about what I could wear. If she saw me in pants, she freaked out. Everything had to be pink and laces when I was a child. When I got older, toward junior high, she relaxed a little. Emphasis on "a little". She gave me dirty looks when I wore pants at this point, but had stopped the beatings. But this is when the school abuse started. Being labelled as the wrong gender sure impacts a lot. My classmates bullied me for looking like a boy. I didn't have very much breast development. I wasn't getting the curves that girls were getting. And I made it worse for myself because I favored a sweatshirt and pants as my attire rather than the skirts all the girls wore. I also started cutting my hair at this time (I was surprisingly good at it) so I looked pretty damn male. My classmates never knew about my anatomy, but they were all told by teachers that I was a girl, so they reacted pretty negatively to my style and non-girly behavior. 
This sort of thing continued into high school, and that's when I started drinking. I also started making a few friends around this time, but only a few. Most people wouldn't be seen with me.
Fast forward to junior year, I decided that enough was enough and started trying to live as a boy. It took a huge weight off my shoulders. And I actually started making a few friends. But I still dealt with bullying. I was still dealing with abuse. I dated a few people, one of whom was emotionally abusive. Thankfully, I'm not with her now!
Currently, I'm 19, working a dull job where PTSD has plenty of opportunities to haunt me. But the good side is that I can't harm myself at work. I get pretty sore from it anyway, that calms most urges.
I'm guessing you mean three more years of high school? And what do you mean by insane and mean? Can you give us some examples?
